notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Sections 175 and 175a, relating to Territory of Alaska, were omitted in view of admission of Alaska into the Union. Section 175, act July 31, 1946, ch. 719, § 1, 60 Stat. 750, authorized establishment of a geophysical institute at the University of Alaska. Section 175a, act July 31, 1946, ch. 719, § 2, 60 Stat. 751, provided that buildings and equipment of geophysical institute shall become property of University of Alaska.
